cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected. Thereafter, all symbols which were part of a winning combination explode, and the snake progress meter increases. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the orchid symbol.

wilds.name: Multiplier Wild
wilds.behavior: The multiplier wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except for the orchid symbol. A snake that eats a multiplier wild symbol triggers growth and enters its survival state, if not already secured.

multipliers.name: Multiplier Wild
multipliers.behavior: The multiplier wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except for the orchid symbol. A snake that eats a multiplier wild symbol triggers growth and enters its survival state, if not already secured.

base_game_loop.summary: Coba Reborn: paid spin on 7x7. Cluster wins (5 connecting symbols). Avalanche/tumble after wins. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 7x7. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: Cluster wins (5 connecting symbols)

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected. Thereafter, all symbols which were part of a winning combination explode, and the snake progress meter increases. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

Game description
Legend speaks of a flower hidden in deepest Borneo that provides immortal life. Local villagers speak of a temple filled with riches, but warn any treasure hunters that it is guarded by unkillable giant snakes. Your goal is to climb the temple and level up to be rewarded by snakes entering the game grid, and these snakes combined with powerful orchids will help generate larger win clusters and create multiplier wilds.

Coba Reborn is a cluster game with symbol win explosions and symbol gravity that keep the game going. Wins are collected towards level ups where "walking cluster" snakes enter the game alone or in larger groups. The snakes eat symbols to grow and stay alive to be able to create even larger win clusters for big win crescendos.
